data.name: intensity_12m
data.label: Deadly violence
data.meaning: How many people were killed in political violence, relative to population.

data.name: escalation_3m
data.label: Escalation
data.meaning: Whether killings rose or fell in the last 3 months compared with the 3 before.

data.name: unrest_z
data.label: Unrest signal
data.meaning: Protests and riots in the last 3 months vs the country's usual level.

data.name: cost_continue_h5
data.label: Cost if fighting continues
data.meaning: How much poorer people would be in 5 years if today's fighting continued.

data.name: peace_dividend_h5
data.label: Gain from stopping now
data.unit: % points of GDP per person after 5 years
data.meaning: How much income is saved if fighting stops after this year instead of 4 more years.

data.name: extra_poor_h5
data.label: People pushed into poverty
data.meaning: Extra people in extreme poverty if today's fighting continued for 5 years.

data.name: neighbor_exposure
data.label: Neighborhood exposure
data.meaning: Income lost because of fighting in nearby countries, if it continues.

meta.note: Associational estimates (two-way FE local projections), not causal effects.
